name: Show File to User
description: Deliver a workspace file to the user's chat: images are displayed inline, HTML pages get an open button, anything else a download link. Use after writing the file (e.g. file_write an HTML report, then show it). The file itself is not sent through the conversation.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the file to show (e.g. report.html or _resources/chart.png)

title.description: Short human title shown next to the file (defaults to the file name)
